messages:
ajay: Quick sync — final checklist for model-catalog GA tomorrow morning. Need explicit owners for licensing signoff, perf profile, canary config, deploy rollback. Also need a quick gap check on metadata (tokenizer, quant tag). Who's claiming which?
tara: I'll own orion-7b perf profile. I have a preliminary profile in s3://redwood-curation/orion7b/perf.json. Will run throughput sweep tonight and post numbers.
kevin: I'll own licensing for orion-7b and fenrir-6b. FYI legal asked about third-party weights for the "mosaic-lite" fork — pinged @legal for confirmation. :handshake:
liz: Eng-runtime here — we need KV cache policy and max-prefix for orion-7b. Default cache windows might OOM on 80k seq. Suggest cache_keep=20k for GA. Will add runtime patch if owners agree.
marta: I'm deployment lead for GA. Canary plan: 5% for 2h, 20% for 6h, then full. If perf regression >10% we rollback to v1.2.2. Need canary route + fallback model variant names.
catalog-bot: Created catalog PR #789 with metadata updates and quantization tags. Link: https://git.redwood/catalog/pull/789
ajay: @tara confirm you can post the perf numbers by 22:00 PT? Also @kevin — can you get legal ack before 09:00 tomorrow?
tara: yes, I'll run the sweep at 17:00 PT, will TL;DR results in thread. Expect data for latency/throughput and 99th/50th.
kevin: legal said mosaic-lite needs a disclaimer and source url in metadata. I'll update PR and ping again.
liz: runtime patch ready in branch runtime/cache-protect-orion, demoed on staging. small config snippet:
```
model: orion-7b
cache_keep: 20000
max_segment: 8192
```
will open deploy PR.
marta: can we name fallback variant 'orion-7b-int8' for fast fallback? that won't accept kv-cache, so runtime will auto-switch on capacity.
ajay: good. Also need eval set owners for quality regression monitoring: @tara for orion, @marta for fenrir.
tara: noted. Will add evaluation prompts under /evals/orion/ga-set and kick off baseline run.
kevin: updated PR with license_url and disclaimer. catalog-bot pls re-index.
catalog-bot: Re-index started for PR #789. ETA 6m. :gear:
legal-bot: Legal ack: mosaic-lite license OK with attribution clause. See ticket LEG-4321.
marta: final ask — who owns the rollout runbook snippet for after-incident rollback? I'll draft and share.
ajay: @marta go ahead, share in #eng-oncall as well. Everyone else, please react with :thumbsup: once your tasks confirmed.
tara: :thumbsup: will post perf tonight.
kevin: :thumbsup: updated license.
liz: :thumbsup: runtime PR opened.
marta: :thumbsup: runbook draft will be in thread in 30m.
